description:
Comfort & Convenience Await at This 4-Bedroom Gem Near Fort Cavazos!

Discover comfort and convenience at 2205 Caprice Dr, a well-maintained 4-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom home offers a massive fenced-in back yard. This inviting property offers spacious living areas, ideal for relaxing or entertaining, and an open floor plan that seamlessly connects the living room, dining area, and kitchen. The kitchen is fully equipped with appliances, ample cabinetry, and plenty of counter space, perfect for preparing your favorite meals. The primary bedroom provides a private retreat, complete with an en-suite bathroom, while the additional bedrooms offer plenty of space for your love ones. Step outside to a large fenced backyard, perfect for outdoor activities and enjoying Texas sunshine..

Conveniently located near local schools, shopping, dining, and Fort Cavazos, this home offers easy access to everything you need.
